methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The presentation briefly looks at two aspects of ISO 50001;  on the initial implementation of a successful system and on ensuring that the input into the ISO system is valid data

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Practitioner conference presentation on implementing ISO 50001 via the SMART approach, electricity metering, and aM&T (automatic Monitoring & Targeting). EnB (ISO 50006) and the 'relevant variables'/drivers concept (production volume, Degree Days) appear only as generic ISO 50001 Clause 4.6.1 requirements; no EnPI/EnB model is presented or characterised (no functional form, construction, or estimation approach identified).
